intended_behavior: Add a private boolean attribute _dirty initialized to False within the constructor __init__. Modify the set() and delete() methods to set _dirty to True whenever an update or deletion occurs to mark the state as changed. Add a private method _is_dirty() that returns the current dirty flag status. Add a private method _clear_dirty() that resets the dirty flag to False, to be used after a successful synchronization. This allows tracking whether the state has been modified since the last sync.

Enhance the sync_agent() method to cache the last known _internal_state of the agent being synchronized. Before calling update_agent(), check if either the agent’s state is dirty by calling agent.state._is_dirty() or if the current _internal_state differs from the cached one. Call update_agent() only when one or both of these conditions indicate a change. After a successful sync, reset the dirty flag via agent.state._clear_dirty() and update the cached internal state. If the sync fails, retain the dirty flag set so that retry attempts will still trigger an update. This behavior optimizes synchronization, preventing unnecessary write operations while preserving correctness.
